capabilities: move pinned tabs to the left end of the tab bar
place newly pinned tabs in the next slot right of existing pinned tabs
reposition unpinned tabs to the right of the pinned group
extras: Can only be installed through BRAT as a beta plugin, not the community plugin store; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted tab behavior that more closely mimics some web browsers, where pinned tabs stay on the left.
problem: Obsidian does not group or reposition pinned tabs, so they can end up scattered anywhere in the tab bar.
summary: Tab behavior utility that keeps pinned tabs grouped at the left end of the tab bar, mimicking how web browsers arrange pinned tabs.
